hypothesis: Removing only the fresh canonical breakout-onset requirement may recover repeatable ETH compression-pullback opportunities after realistic execution costs without degrading the frozen 60-bps stop behavior.
decision: Keep v53 unchanged and continue the isolated future-only observer without retuning. The third non-overlapping long path lost after recorded visible-depth execution, fees, and official funding. The frozen sample is now negative in total, negative at the median, below profit factor one, more negative after removing its only winner, and has no short-side evidence. Do not add ETH or remove the onset requirement.
why_this_revision: The right-boundary candidate from revision 12 obtained a causal entry and full 15-minute horizon. It became the second loss, changing the frozen experiment from a slightly positive but winner-dependent N=2 sample to a negative N=3 long-only sample.

future_one_blocker_experiment.candidate_definition: exactly two of three frozen entry conditions met with canonical_breakout_onset_absent as the sole blocker
future_one_blocker_experiment.entry: first complete visible-depth executable quote causally available after routing publication
future_one_blocker_experiment.overlap_policy: suppress additional same-side candidates until the primary horizon resolves
future_one_blocker_experiment.minimum_evidence: At least 20 independent candidates with both sides represented, complete exact-depth entry and exit paths, positive primary-horizon mean and median after nominal cost, positive stress mean after removing the largest winner, and no worse stop-path behavior than the frozen route.

interpretation.comparison_with_no_action: Keeping v53 unchanged remains preferred because the sole-blocker ETH relaxation is negative after recorded costs, negative at the median, entirely long-side, and still sparse.

risks_and_failure_modes: Three results remain far below the predeclared twenty-candidate minimum.
The aggregate, median, and largest-winner-removed result are all negative.
All resolved candidates are long-side, leaving the configured short side untested.
Recorded visible depth can cancel before a live IOC reaches the venue.
The stop proxy uses adverse BBO rather than an exact venue mark-trigger fill.
A fixed 15-minute diagnostic does not reproduce the route's full native maximum-hold lifecycle.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep v53 and the ETH onset requirement unchanged; continue the frozen observer only to test whether materially new future evidence can overturn the negative sample.
recommendation.Why now: The third causal path changed the marginal relaxation from weakly positive and winner-dependent to negative on total, median, profit factor, and largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Three resolved non-overlapping exact-depth long paths, official hourly funding, taker fees, visible-depth capacity, MFE/MAE, stop proxies, and immutable N=1 and N=2 revisions.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Removing onset admitted one winner and two losses for -1.90 bps total, PF 0.77, and -8.18 bps without the winner.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Observed ETH transition and trend-up structure with prior compression and long pullbacks but no fresh canonical five-minute breakout onset.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Promote after N=1, stop after N=3, retune the horizon, alter stop or target logic, or continue the unchanged preregistered window.
recommendation.Expected upside: Continuing without retuning can determine whether the early negative sample persists without exposing v53 capital or selecting a favorable horizon.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse variance, one-sided sampling, recorded-book cancellation, mark-stop mismatch, native-exit mismatch, and continued research opportunity cost.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact identity and cutoff, three causal entry/exit paths, non-overlap enforcement, visible-depth capacity, official fees and funding, MFE/MAE, stop proxy, median, profit factor, and largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least seventeen additional independent resolved candidates, short-side evidence, full stress arithmetic, exact stop behavior, and native lifecycle comparison.
recommendation.Success metrics: The unchanged twenty-candidate both-side contract with positive nominal mean and median, positive stress result after largest-winner removal, and no worse stop behavior.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Negative, one-sided, unresolved, or outlier-dependent final evidence retains the current onset requirement; source or identity mismatch invalidates the window.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on N=3 arithmetic, low on long-run expectancy

next_highest_value_investigation: Continue exact v53 HYPE lifecycle collection while allowing the frozen ETH observer to accumulate without retuning.
